ja: 私たちは今、銀行の窓口で順番を待っているところです。
en: We're waiting for our turn at the bank.
alternatives: We're waiting in line at the bank now.
We're standing in line at the bank right now.

ja: 兄は今日の午後、修理に出したノートパソコンを受け取りにお店へ行く予定です。
en: My brother is going to the repair shop this afternoon to pick up his laptop.
alternatives: My brother plans to go to the repair shop this afternoon to pick up his laptop.
This afternoon my brother is going to the repair shop to get his laptop back.
point: 「〜しに行く」の目的は to 不定詞で後ろに置く

ja: 妹は郵便局で、この小包を送るにはもう少し情報が必要だと言われました。
en: My sister was told at the post office that they needed some more information to send this package.
alternatives: At the post office, my sister was told they needed more information to send this package.
The post office told my sister they needed some more information to ship this package.
point: information は数えられない名詞、informations や an は不可

ja: この書類に記入したいので、そのペンをお借りしてもいいですか？
en: May I borrow your pen to fill out this form?
alternatives: Could I borrow your pen to fill out this form?
Is it okay if I borrow your pen to fill out this form?
point: 「記入する」は fill out、目的は to で続ける

ja: 市役所の窓口は、土曜日は閉まっています。
en: The city hall counter is closed on Saturdays.
alternatives: The counter at city hall is closed on Saturdays.
The service counter at city hall is closed on Saturdays.
point: 毎週のことなので on Saturdays と複数形

ja: 郵便局の人が、この小包は明日届くって言ってたよ。
en: The person at the post office said this package would arrive tomorrow.
alternatives: The post office clerk said this package will arrive tomorrow.
The guy at the post office told me this package would arrive tomorrow.
point: said の後の that 節は will を would に揃えることが多い

ja: 修理に出したのは画面じゃなくて、バッテリーの方だったんですよ。
en: It was the battery, not the screen, that I took in for repair.
alternatives: What I took in for repair was the battery, not the screen.
It was the battery that I sent in for repair, not the screen.
point: 強調したい語を It was と that の間に挟む

ja: 修理が終わったら、携帯に電話してもらえますか？
en: Could you call my cell phone when the repair is finished?
alternatives: Could you give me a call on my cell when the repair is done?
Can you call my cell phone once the repair is finished?
point: when 節は未来のことでも現在形、will be finished にしない

ja: 郵便局の窓口の人によると、先週私が送った書類がまだ届いていないのは、住所の書き方のせいかもしれないそうです。
en: The clerk at the post office said the reason the documents I sent last week haven't arrived might be the way I wrote the address.
alternatives: According to the post office clerk, the documents I sent last week may not have arrived yet because of how I wrote the address.
The post office clerk told me the documents I mailed last week might not have arrived because of the way I wrote the address.
point: 主語 the reason 〜 arrived が長くても動詞 might be を落とさない

ja: こちらの用紙にお名前を書いてください。
en: Please write your name on this form.
alternatives: Please put your name on this form.
Write your name on this form, please.
point: 用紙に書くは on this form で in ではない

ja: 先月パスポートを更新しておけば、今こんな長い列に並んでいないのに。
en: If I had renewed my passport last month, I wouldn't be standing in this long line now.
alternatives: If I'd renewed my passport last month, I wouldn't be waiting in this long line now.
I wouldn't be stuck in this long line now if I had renewed my passport last month.
point: 過去の条件は had 過去分詞、今の結果は would be 〜ing

ja: この申込書の書き方がよく分からないので、手伝っていただけないかと思いまして。
en: I'm not sure how to fill out this form, so I was wondering if you could help me.
alternatives: I'm not sure how to fill out this form, so I was hoping you could help me.
I don't really know how to fill in this form, so I was wondering if you could help me.
point: 丁寧な依頼は I was wondering if you could で過去形にする

ja: 母は郵便局で、もう30分も列に並んでいます。
en: My mom has been in line at the post office for thirty minutes.
alternatives: My mom has been waiting in line at the post office for thirty minutes.
My mother has been standing in line at the post office for thirty minutes.
point: 今も続いている状態は has been で表す

ja: 私の新しいキャッシュカード、もう郵送してくれましたか？
en: Have you mailed my new bank card yet?
alternatives: Have you already sent my new bank card?
Have you sent out my new bank card yet?
point: 疑問文の「もう」は文末の yet で表す

ja: 修理カウンターで働いている女性が、私のスマホは金曜までに仕上がるって言ってたよ。
en: The woman working at the repair counter said my phone would be ready by Friday.
alternatives: The woman who works at the repair counter said my phone would be ready by Friday.
The woman at the repair counter told me my phone would be ready by Friday.
point: working at 〜 を名詞の後ろに置き、said の後は would で時制を合わせる

ja: 兄は郵便局が閉まる前に着いていれば、昨日のうちに小包を受け取れたのに。
en: If my brother had gotten to the post office before it closed, he could have picked up the package yesterday.
alternatives: My brother could have picked up the package yesterday if he'd gotten to the post office before it closed.
If my brother had made it to the post office before it closed, he could've gotten the package yesterday.
point: 過去の仮定は had＋過去分詞、結果は could have＋過去分詞

ja: 先週キャッシュカードをなくしたんですが、もう銀行で再発行してもらいました。
en: I lost my bank card last week, but I've already had it reissued.
alternatives: I lost my bank card last week, but the bank has already reissued it.
I lost my ATM card last week, but I've already gotten a new one from the bank.
point: 先週は過去形、「もう〜した」は現在完了で分ける

ja: もし海外でキャッシュカードをなくしたら、あなたならまず銀行に電話する、それとも支店に行く？
en: If you lost your bank card abroad, would you call the bank first or go to a branch?
alternatives: If you were to lose your bank card abroad, would you call the bank first or visit a branch?
What would you do first if you lost your bank card abroad, call the bank or go to a branch?
point: 仮の話なので if 節は過去形 lost、主節は would you
